step1_analysis.description: A common-source low-noise amplifier stage with source degeneration. XM1 acts as the main amplifying transistor, while XM2 is diode-connected/shorted to act as a parasitic capacitor or dummy load at the output node.

paper_reference.title: A Noise Optimization Technique for Integrated Low-Noise Amplifiers

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the amplifier.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The parameterized W=5u is relatively small for an LNA, leading to lower power consumption than the 7.5 mW reported in the paper (which likely used much wider transistors).

voltage_gain.description: AC voltage gain at the tuned operating frequency (800 MHz).

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2 * Id / Vov = 390uA / 0.38V ≈ 1.02 mS. With a tuned tank load equivalent resistance of 10 kOhm, Gain = gm * Rload = 10.2 V/V = 20.1 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the Q-factor of the output matching network. A 10k parallel resistor sets a reasonable peak gain.

noise_figure.description: Signal-to-noise ratio degradation through the amplifier at 800 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: NF = 10 * log10(inoise_spectrum / (4*k*T*Rs)). For a simple CS stage in 130nm without perfect noise matching, NF is typically higher than the highly optimized 0.9 dB from the paper.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper achieves 0.9 dB through rigorous noise optimization and sizing. The default W=5u is not noise-optimal, so NF will be higher.

operating_frequency.description: The center frequency where the LNA achieves peak gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)). With L=10nH and C=39.5pF, f ≈ 800 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Set explicitly by the LC tank components added in the testbench to match the paper's 800 MHz target.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain, and Noise Figure at 800 MHz for the LNA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* LNA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N1 N2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 GND N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Supplies and Bias
Vdd VDD 0 1.8
Vbias Vbias_node 0 0.8

* Input Network (50 Ohm source)
Vac in_ac 0 dc 0 ac 1
Rs in_ac net_in 50
C2 net_in N2 10p
Rbias Vbias_node N2 10k

* Source Degeneration Inductor
L2 N0 0 1n

* Output Matching Network (Tuned for ~800 MHz)
L1 VDD N1 10n
C1 VDD N1 39.5p
R1 VDD N1 10k

.control
* 1. DC Power
op
let power = -i(Vdd) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Gain
ac dec 50 100Meg 10Gig
let gain_db = vdb(N1)
meas ac gain_800m find gain_db at=800Meg

* 3. Noise Figure
* 4*k*T*Rs = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300 * 50 = 8.28e-19
noise v(N1) Vac dec 50 100Meg 10Gig
setplot noise1
let nf_db = 10 * log10(inoise_spectrum / 8.28e-19)
meas noise nf_at_800m find nf_db at=800Meg

quit
.endc
